changes.before:
A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.
This is caused by body and mind being overwhelmed by awe and fear after coming into contact with the power of the $$御使い$$.
Those from whom life force has been excessively absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ also sense the presence of the $$御使い$$, the destination to which that power is sent, and fall into the same symptoms.
In theory, it can be overcome by anyone with enough mental strength to throw off the pressure of the $$御使い$$, but for ordinary humans this is basically impossible.

changes.before:
A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.
The founding of $$クロノ$$ was triggered by humanity's landing on the surface of the Moon. Those who submitted to the message of the $$御使い$$ left behind there, 'Humanity is a species that is not permitted to evolve', and to that power have since managed the history of humanity... or, in other words, its evolution... under their direction.
Those who opposed this way of being founded the Reformists from within, but they were overwhelmingly inferior in strength, and those who tried to make the managers of humanity public were also silenced by means such as assassination.
After the invasion of $$蒼の地球$$ by $$サイデリアル$$, it became entirely a subordinate organization of the $$新地球皇国$$, but after its existence was made public and the Empire was overthrown, it gradually lost its power, fading away of its own accord.

changes.before:
A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with their family, the patient alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving them in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and they sometimes cry out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.
When their spirit particles (i.e. life force) were absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ built by the $$御使い$$, the $$血塗られた眼$$ set in again, but with the defeat of the $$御使い$$ they completely overcame the symptoms and showed themselves in good health.

changes.before:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
This spacequake was brought about by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, one of the $$御使い$$, in order to protect the humans of $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ who were showing signs of evolution: it first fused the two Earths, then split them in two again, using one of them (the $$翠の地球$$) as camouflage to hide the other (the $$蒼の地球$$) from the eyes of the other $$御使い$$.

changes.before:
A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.
It was later revealed that its very existence had been part of $$ジエー$$'s plan to overthrow the $$御使い$$.

changes.before:
An agent robot of the $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$, an enterprise group that operates across parallel worlds. Its name is short for 'AGENT.'
It fell to Earth caught up in a dimensional tremor together with the $$ジェニオン$$, and since then has overseen the $$ジェニオン$$'s field tests for the purpose of gathering data.
It also runs the dimensional shop '$$Ｄトレーダー$$,' stocked through its own private supply routes, and personally serves as its guide.
A flippant sort, it shows more rich emotion than one would expect from a robot, and often stirs up trouble around it. At the same time, it is sensitive to other people's subtle feelings, and can be surprisingly caring, offering advice that delves into their inner feelings.
After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, it considered returning to $$ＤＥＭ$$ together with the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, which had reached a provisional completion.
After working with $$トライア・スコート$$ to complete the $$ソーラリアン$$, which is also a system for operating the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, it also began to take the field as its operator.
Its true identity is a collective of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$s who exist in various parallel worlds; $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ serves as the main personality as their representative, and $$エルガン・ローディック$$ of the $$ＡＤＷ$$ assists.
In using others as tools for its own ends it is no different from $$ジエー$$, but owing to the influence of its other personalities it also has a certain degree of conscience and good sense. In addition, its greatest goal lies in the defeat of the $$御使い$$, and to achieve it, it shows a willingness to cooperate with others.
At the hyperspacetime restoration, carrying the force of annihilation that could not be fully canceled out, it vanished beyond the causal horizon together with $$聖アドヴェント$$.

changes.before:
A young man who committed a great sin in the past and, denied even the release of death, wanders through various spacetimes together with $$シュロウガ$$.
Hoping to escape that fate by obtaining the power of the $$太極$$, he pilots $$シュロウガ$$ into the battles of the holders of the $$スフィア$$s, which are fragments of the will of the $$太極$$.
He has already claimed four $$スフィア$$s -- the $$知りたがる山羊$$, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, and one of unknown name -- but at the end of the $$再世戦争$$ he was sealed away within the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars.
However, he was freed by persons unknown, and is again working in the shadows to obtain the $$スフィア$$s for his own purposes.
His true nature is an image produced by '$$シュロウガ$$', a system that sought to control the $$アカシックレコード$$; strictly speaking he cannot be called a living being, but his thoughts and feelings are no different from a human's.
His goal was to overthrow the $$御使い$$ who cursed him with immortality and ordered him to gather all the $$スフィア$$s, and his ultimate goal was to be freed from immortality by the power of the $$スフィア$$s and to die.
He was once absorbed by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and became a part of $$至高神Ｚ$$, but through his wish for death he succeeded in robbing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ of eternity. After $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was defeated, he was freed from the curse of immortality and set out for a new world.
changes.after:
A young man who committed a great sin in the past and, denied even the release of death, wanders through various spacetimes together with $$シュロウガ$$.
Hoping to escape that fate by obtaining the power of the $$太極$$, he pilots $$シュロウガ$$ into the battles of the holders of the $$スフィア$$s, which are fragments of the will of the $$太極$$.
He has already claimed four $$スフィア$$s -- the $$知りたがる山羊$$, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, and one of unknown name -- but at the end of the $$再世戦争$$ he was sealed away within the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars.
However, he was freed by persons unknown, and is again working in the shadows to obtain the $$スフィア$$s for his own purposes.
His true nature is an image produced by '$$シュロウガ$$', a system that sought to control the $$アカシックレコード$$; strictly speaking he cannot be called a living being, but his thoughts and feelings are no different from a human's.
His goal was to overthrow the $$御使い$$s who cursed him with immortality and ordered him to gather all the $$スフィア$$s, and his ultimate goal was to be freed from immortality by the power of the $$スフィア$$s and to die.
He was once absorbed by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and became a part of $$至高神Ｚ$$, but through his wish for death he succeeded in robbing $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ of eternity. After $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was defeated, he was freed from the curse of immortality and set out for a new world.

changes.before:
One of the $$御使い$$s, a being that governs the emotion of 'pleasure.'
When first awakened as an $$御使い$$, she enjoyed guiding evolution as the mission of a higher-dimensional life form, but came to find it amusing to watch other lives scramble about because of her own decisions, and from then on exercising that power became the main focus.
At the banishment of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ 12,000 years ago as well, she agreed with the proposal of $$ドクトリン$$ simply because a situation in which the $$御使い$$s were reduced by one seemed like fun, and banished $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.

changes.before:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$尸空#pilot$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.
Its name is read '$$尸逝天$$.'
It has the appearance of the corpse of a huge creature, and dominates the atmosphere of the battlefield together with the silent pressure of its pilot, $$尸空#pilot$$.
It has high firepower and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.
Its true nature is the remains of a creature that dwells between life and death and can cross the boundary between the two, a being that transcends the natural order by continuing to exist even after death.
When armor and other components are attached to its offspring, it becomes a $$尸冥爪$$.
It has stayed with the successive chiefs of $$鬼宿$$, who, though living beings, govern the 'force that seeks to vanish,' and is now owned by $$尸刻$$, the current head of $$鬼宿$$.
After being defeated in the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, it offered up its $$スフィア$$ together with $$尸空#pilot$$, who had entrusted the defeat of the $$御使い$$ to $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$, and departed for the far reaches of the causal horizon.

changes.before:
A battleship piloted by $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.
As the flagship of $$エルーナルーナ$$, who serves as commander of all the forces of the $$新地球皇国$$, it is also the flagship of the Empire.
Its basic design is the same as the $$アルデバル$$ piloted by $$ハイアデス$$, but thanks to the power of the $$スフィア$$ it carries and the skill of $$エルーナルーナ$$, it boasts breakthrough power and offensive power that overwhelm all others.
Its overwhelming presence, shining gold, together with the command ability of $$エルーナルーナ$$, is a symbol of victory for $$サイデリアル$$ and is very popular even with front-line soldiers other than $$ハイアデス$$.
It was originally a customized $$アルデバル$$ that the previous leader of $$ハイアデス$$, a combat group wandering the galaxy, gave to his daughter $$エルーナルーナ$$, and it carried the $$スフィア$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$, before its awakening, as its power source.
When $$サイデリアル$$ took $$ハイアデス$$ under its command, $$エルーナルーナ$$ lost her father to them, but at the words of $$アウストラリス$$ promising to provide a place for still more fighting, she awakened the $$スフィア$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.
While affirming herself for having been unable to suppress the surge of her blood, $$エルーナルーナ$$ swore before $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$, which had become her father's keepsake, to defeat the $$御使い$$.
After being defeated in the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, it perished together with $$エルーナルーナ$$ in order to offer its $$スフィア$$ to $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$, as had long been promised.

The true form of $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, whose identity as a $$次元将$$ has been revealed.
The equipment corresponding to what $$ヴィシュラカーラ$$ is for $$ガイオウ$$ has been lost, but combining the power of a $$次元将$$ with the $$スフィア$$ of the $$立ち上がる射手$$ that he holds himself and the power of the three $$スフィア$$s he has absorbed produces transcendent combat strength.

Bearing the name of the sun god, it displays overwhelming power beyond human comprehension.
It is a sacred treasure created from the core of $$至高神ソル$$ when it shattered 12,000 years ago, and was given as a final mercy to $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who had been exiled from the $$御使い$$.

changes.before:
A mobile weapon under the direct command of the $$御使い$$.
Its entire body is composed of $$ＤＥＣ$$ (Dimension Energy Crystal / Dimensional Crystal), and its operation and armament are all powered by the Power of Origin.
It is mainly piloted by $$イドム$$, a spirit-form being, who turns craving for a body and for life directly into power to attack the living. It boasts combat strength greater than the $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$, and it was this unit that defeated $$エルーナルーナ$$'s father, the previous leader of $$ハイアデス$$.
In addition, one to three are sent to each star watched over by the $$御使い$$; each awakens when that star begins to go down a path of evolution against the will of the $$御使い$$, and has the role of destroying its civilization. It is feared in galactic legend under the name 'Giant Beast of Judgment.'
Incidentally, the $$次元獣$$s used by the Dimensional Generals were developed using this unit as a model.

changes.id:
謎の存在「テンシ」が引き起こす時空震動に巻き込まれながらも生き残った
者に現れる症状。
　両目が赤くなり、感情が死んだような状態となる。
　これは御使いの力に接触した事によって畏怖と恐怖に心身が支配された事が
原因である。
　霊子吸収システムで過度に生命の力を吸収された者も、その力が送られる先
である御使いの存在を感じ、同様の症状に陥る。
　理屈では御使いの圧力を跳ね返すだけの精神力があれば克服は出来るが、通
常の人間では基本的には不可能である。
changes.before:
A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.
This is caused by body and mind being overwhelmed by awe and fear after coming into contact with the power of the $$御使い$$.
Those from whom life force has been excessively absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ also sense the presence of the $$御使い$$, the destination to which that power is sent, and fall into the same symptoms.
In theory, it can be overcome by anyone with enough mental strength to throw off the pressure of the $$御使い$$, but for ordinary humans this is basically impossible.

changes.id:
それぞれの並行世界に存在し、人類の歴史を影から操ってきた組織の総称。
　その構成員は世襲であり、キングと呼ばれる最高権力者と１３人評議会と呼
ばれる意思決定機関が存在する。
　保守派と改革派と呼ばれる対立する二つのグループが存在しており、それぞ
れ「人類の進化を監視する者」「人類の進化を見守る者」を自称している。
　その内の保守派が主流であり、政財界や軍部に強い影響力を持つ。各並行世
界のスペースノイドの弾圧は彼等の指示によるものである。
　時獄戦役においてはジェミニスのガドライトに協力し、その指示に従って行
動していた。
　クロノの設立は人類が月面に降り立った事を契機とする。そこに残されてい
た御使いのメッセージ「人類は進化する事を許されない種である」と、その力
に服従した者達は、以降は彼等の指示の下、人類の歴史…言い換えれば進化を
管理してきた。
　その在り方に反対した者が内部から改革派を立ち上げたが、勢力的には圧倒
的に劣勢であり、人類の管理者を公表しようとした者達も暗殺などの手段によ
って葬られてきた。
　サイデリアルの蒼の地球侵攻後は、完全に新地球皇国の下部組織となったが、
その存在が公表され、皇国が打倒された後は自然消滅的に力を失っていった。
changes.before:
A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.
The founding of $$クロノ$$ was triggered by humanity's landing on the surface of the Moon. Those who submitted to the message of the $$御使い$$ left behind there, 'Humanity is a species that is not permitted to evolve', and to that power have since managed the history of humanity... or, in other words, its evolution... under their direction.
Those who opposed this way of being founded the Reformists from within, but they were overwhelmingly inferior in strength, and those who tried to make the managers of humanity public were also silenced by means such as assassination.
After the invasion of $$蒼の地球$$ by $$サイデリアル$$, it became entirely a subordinate organization of the $$新地球皇国$$, but after its existence was made public and the Empire was overthrown, it gradually lost its power, fading away of its own accord.

changes.id:
ＵＣＷの新地球連邦軍の特殊部隊。
　エーデル・ベルナル准将を指揮官に三番隊までが存在し、それぞれの隊長で
あるレーベル・ゲネラール、シュラン・オペル、ツィーネ・エスピオと研究開
発部門担当のジエー・ベイベルで構成されている。
　大時空震動直後の混乱した世界に秩序を打ち立てる事を目的としていたが、
それは独善に満ちたものであり、世界征服と同義であった。
　首魁であるエーデルが倒された後、黒幕であるジエーは真の姿のジ・エーデ
ル・ベルナルとなり、ＺＥＵＴＨに戦いを挑むものの敗れ去り、カイメラも壊
滅した。
　後にその存在自体がジエーの御使い打倒計画の一部であった事が明らかにな
った。
changes.before:
A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.
It was later revealed that its very existence had been part of $$ジエー$$'s plan to overthrow the $$御使い$$.

changes.id:
フルネームは白井美沙子。
　第２新東京市立総合病院の特別室に入院していた患者。
　家族と共に次元震に巻き込まれ、本人だけが生き残る。その後、「血塗られ
た眼」と呼ばれる現象を発症しており、感情の一切を消失しているかのような
状態になっている。唯一、恐怖の感情のみが残っており、発作的に何かに怯え
て悲鳴を上げる事がある。
　時の牢獄の完成が近付くに連れ、発作の回数は増加していたが、時空修復後
は落ち着きを見せるようになり、回復が期待されている。
　御使いの造り上げた霊子吸収システムによって霊子（＝生命の力）を吸収さ
れた際、再び血塗られた眼を発症するが、御使いが打倒された事で完全に症状
を克服し、元気な姿を見せた。
changes.before:
Full name: $$白井美沙子$$.
A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with her family, she alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving her in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and she sometimes cries out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.
When her spirit particles (i.e. life force) were absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ built by the $$御使い$$, the $$血塗られた眼$$ set in again, but with the defeat of the $$御使い$$ she completely overcame the symptoms and showed herself in good health.

changes.id:
ＵＣＷとＡＤＷ、その他の世界が一つになった巨大な時空震動。
　規模は巨大ではあったが、物理的な被害は比較的少なく、文化的に似通って
いたＵＣＷとＡＤＷは早々に事態を把握し、互いに協力体勢を取る事が出来た。
その結果、わずか３ヶ月でスペースコロニーを含む巨大政治組織、地球連邦が
誕生し、人々の生活も短時間で平穏を取り戻した。
　この時空震動は、御使いの一人である哀しみのサクリファイが進化の兆しを
見せていたＵＣＷとＡＤＷの人間を守る事を目的に、二つの地球を一度融合さ
せた後、再度二つに分け、その片方（＝翠の地球）をカモフラージュにして、
もう片方（＝蒼の地球）を他の御使いの眼から隠すためのものであった。
changes.before:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
This spacequake was brought about by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, one of the $$御使い$$, in order to protect the humans of $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ who were showing signs of evolution: it first fused the two Earths, then split them in two again, using one of them (the $$翠の地球$$) as camouflage to hide the other (the $$蒼の地球$$) from the eyes of the other $$御使い$$.
